messages:
zoe_sales: FYI — Sovereign-payments wants a POC scoped to EU + UK only (they specifically called out UK post-Brexit). Must provide: full EU+UK subprocessor list, BYO-HSM support, and statement that model checkpoints and inference logs stay in-region. Any quick no-go items?
carl_presales: UK adds an extra legal check but operationally similar to eu-west/ eu-central. What's expected load?
zoe_sales: Rough profile: low latency chat during business hours ~120 qps, nightly batch embeddings ~50k vectors. Tail latency target p95 <300ms. They asked if we can discount POC dedicated capacity or provide short-term reserved units.
mika_security: BYO-HSM: supported only on Dedicated and Private. Hosted can do envelope or bring-your-own-key with partner KMS but not full HSM customer keys. For evidence: we can supply SOC2, subprocessors CSV, and a DPIA summary; for UK addendum we'll need dataprotection team's sign-off.
gabe_ops: Ops note: subprocessors for EU+UK: AWS eu-west-2 (London), AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland), GCP europe-west1, Azure northeurope, CDN partner (fastcdn-ie), monitoring vendor (obsrv-eu). I'll prepare an export with contact points.
redwood-deploy-bot: Ticket PRESALES-UK-EU-009 created. Attach: https://internal/presales/PRESALES-UK-EU-009.
tina_ae: Procurement asked: can we ensure inference logs never leave region, even for control-plane operations like model health pings? They want wording suitable for contract appendix.
mika_security: Short answer: full guarantee for control-plane locality requires Dedicated or Private. For hosted with region pinning we can guarantee data plane egress stays in EU/UK but control-plane telemetry may go to control nodes in other regions unless we enable dedicated control-plane routing. I'll draft contract wording: "Data and inference artifacts will be processed and stored only in the EU/UK regions specified; control-plane telemetry may be restricted by mutual agreement when dedicated control-plane is purchased."
carl_presales: For the POC pricing: we can offer a timeboxed dedicated pool promo: 2 weeks of dedicated capacity at 30% off, or hosted with pinned routing + SLA caveats. Need commercial OK. Is the infra impact acceptable for a short promo?
gabe_ops: From ops: short promo fine but needs ticket and capacity reservation. For 120qps p95<300ms with small-context chats, recommended baseline: 1x A10 (or 2x T4s) with warm KV caching; for safe headroom during spikes add a hot standby. Nightly embedding job: schedule in off-peak or use transient workers.
tina_ae: Customer also asked for a sample routing policy and a sample contract appendix line for procurement. Can we drop both here?
carl_presales: Routing sample (presales doc):

```
routing_policy:
  tenant_id: sovereign-payments
  data_plane_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-west-2]
  control_plane_mode: dedicated-controlplane-eu-uk  # requires dedicated purchase
  subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-1, aws-eu-west-2, gcp-europe-west1, azure-northeurope, fastcdn-ie, obsrv-eu]
  kms_mode: byo-hsm
  telemetry_level: minimal
  fallthrough: deny
```

carl_presales: Sample contract appendix snippet: "Redwood will process, store, and retain model checkpoints, inference logs, and derived embeddings only within the Customer-specified EU/UK regions. Control-plane functions may be routed outside those regions unless a Dedicated or Private control-plane is contracted; dedicated control-plane terms shall be detailed in Schedule X." (mika will refine legal language)
mika_security: I'll produce the legal-approved appendix and attach SOC2 + DPIA extracts. Expect first draft by EOD tomorrow.
gabe_ops: I'll attach subprocessors_export.csv and an ops playbook for tenant pinning to the PRESALES ticket.
tina_ae: I'll hold off procurement handoff til we have the appendix + cost scenario. Zoe, can you confirm customer flexibility on the 2-week POC window?
zoe_sales: Yup, customer is open to a 2-week dedicated trial if we can provide the security artifacts and a discounted rate. I'll ask them for preferred dates.
carl_presales: Action items recap: 1) gabe attach subprocessors CSV + ops playbook (today). 2) mika draft legal appendix + telemetry note (tomorrow EOD). 3) gabe + infra to size perf/cost for 120qps baseline + embedding batch (tomorrow afternoon). 4) carl to spin up presales pricing proposal with 2-week promo option. 5) zoe to confirm dates with customer.
zoe_sales: Thanks all — will update thread after procurement reply. :rocket:
